<style>
  /* --- TALK CARD STYLES --- */

    border-left: 5px solid var(--bs-primary, #031C59);
    padding: 1.5rem 2rem;
    margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    border-radius: 0 12px 12px 0;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease;
  }
  
  .talk-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-3px);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
    background: rgba(0, 139, 210, 0.08);
  }

  body.quarto-dark .talk-card {
    background: rgba(198, 198, 198, 0.1);
    border-color: #99ddff;
  }

  .talk-title-link {
    color: var(--bs-primary, #031C59);
    font-size: 1.3rem;
    font-weight: 700;
    text-decoration: none;
    margin-top: 0;
    margin-bottom: 0.2rem;
    display: inline-block;
  }

  .talk-title-link:hover {
    text-decoration: underline;
  }
  
  body.quarto-dark .talk-title-link {
    color: #99ddff;
  }

  .talk-meta {

## {{< iconify fa-solid:bullhorn >}} &nbsp; Incoming talks
<div id="talks-incoming"></div>

## {{< iconify fa6-solid:clock-rotate-left >}} &nbsp; Past talks

### &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Conferences
<div id="talks-conferences"></div>

### &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; Symposiums and Mini-Conferences
<div id="talks-symposiums"></div>

## {{< iconify ion:easel >}} &nbsp; Co-organised Symposiums
<div id="talks-organised"></div>

<!-- =======================================================
     THE DATA FETCHER AND LOGIC FOR THE TALKS APP
     ======================================================= -->
<script>
  let talksData = [];

  // Fetch the YAML file automatically (Ensure the path is correct for your repo)
  fetch('resources/talks/talks.yml')
    .then(response => {
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error("Could not find talks.yml");
      return response.text();
    })
    .then(yamlText => {
      talksData = jsyaml.load(yamlText);
      
      if (talksData && talksData.length > 0) {
        // Sort talks by date (Newest to Oldest)
        talksData.sort((a, b) => new Date(b.date) - new Date(a.date));
        renderTalks();
      }
    })
    .catch(error => {
      console.error("Error loading talks:", error);
      document.getElementById('talks-conferences').innerHTML = "<p><em>Loading talks... (Ensure talks.yml is deployed).</em></p>";
    });

  function createTalkCard(talk) {
    let html = `<div class="talk-card">`;
    
    // Title with Website Link
    if(talk.website) {
      html += `<a href="${talk.website}" target="_blank" class="talk-title-link">${talk.event}</a>`;
    } else {
      html += `<h3 class="talk-title-link" style="margin-bottom:0;">${talk.event}</h3>`;
    }

    // Metadata (Location and Date)
    html += `<div class="talk-meta">${talk.location}, ${new Date(talk.date).toLocaleDateString('en-GB', {day: 'numeric', month: 'long', year: 'numeric'})}</div>`;

    // Talk Details
    html += `<div class="talk-details">
               <p><strong>Title:</strong> ${talk.title}</p>
               <p><strong>Authors:</strong> ${talk.authors}</p>
             </div>`;

    // Buttons Container
    html += `<div class="talk-buttons">`;
    
    if(talk.slides) {
      html += `<a href="${talk.slides}" target="_blank" class="btn btn-outline-primary rounded-pill btn-sm">{{< iconify fa-solid:chalkboard >}} Slides</a>`;
    }
    if(talk.abstract) {
      html += `<a href="${talk.abstract}" target="_blank" class="btn btn-outline-primary rounded-pill btn-sm">{{< iconify fa-regular:file >}} Abstract</a>`;
    }
    if(talk.code) {
      html += `<a href="${talk.code}" target="_blank" class="btn btn-outline-primary rounded-pill btn-sm">{{< iconify fa-solid:code >}} Code</a>`;
    }
    if(talk.code2) {
      html += `<a href="${talk.code2}" target="_blank" class="btn btn-outline-primary rounded-pill btn-sm">{{< iconify fa-solid:code >}} Code 2</a>`;
    }
    
    html += `</div></div>`;
    return html;
  }

  function renderTalks() {
    const confContainer = document.getElementById('talks-conferences');
    const sympContainer = document.getElementById('talks-symposiums');
    const orgContainer = document.getElementById('talks-organised');
    const incomingContainer = document.getElementById('talks-incoming'); // Fixed variable name
    
    let hasIncoming = false;

    // Get today's date (with time zeroed out for accurate comparison)
    const today = new Date();
    today.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);

    talksData.forEach(talk => {
      const cardHTML = createTalkCard(talk);
      const talkDate = new Date(talk.date);
      
      // If the talk date is greater than or equal to today, it goes to Incoming!
      if (talkDate >= today) {
        incomingContainer.innerHTML += cardHTML;
        hasIncoming = true;
      } 
      // If the talk is in the past, route it based on its category
      else {
        if(talk.category === "Conferences") {
          confContainer.innerHTML += cardHTML;
        } else if (talk.category === "Symposiums") {
          sympContainer.innerHTML += cardHTML;
        } else if (talk.category === "Organised") {
          orgContainer.innerHTML += cardHTML;
        }
      }
    });

    // Display a nice message if there are no upcoming talks
    if (!hasIncoming) {
      incomingContainer.innerHTML = "<p style='color: var(--bs-body-color); font-style: italic; margin-left: 20px;'>No upcoming talks currently scheduled.</p>";
    }
  }
</script>
